# Models Directory

This directory stores the trained SignBridge model files.

## Files (generated by `train_model.py`)

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `signbridge_model.keras` | Trained Keras model (CNN) |
| `class_indices.json` | Mapping of class names to integer indices |

## Usage

These files are generated automatically when you run:
```bash
python train_model.py
```

The Flask app (`app.py`) loads the model from this directory on startup.

## Note
Model files are excluded from Git (see `.gitignore`) due to their size.
After cloning the repository, you must train the model before predictions will work.
